cost_model_correction.what_i_said: A balance drop of 163 after one take, implying the take cost 163 and the batch was about three times my estimate.
cost_model_correction.what_is_true: The take cost exactly 56, as preflighted. The transaction ledger shows it as a single -56 Seedance charge at 08:07:34. My 7 credits per second figure for 720p was right and the 651 batch estimate stands.
cost_model_correction.why_i_misread_it: I inferred the take's cost by differencing the account balance, and this account is also being spent from outside this session. The same ledger window shows a -98 Seedance charge at 07:56:43 and GPT Image charges of -2.75 three times and -4.5 twice that none of my calls made, about 115 credits in total. Differencing a shared balance is not a cost measurement.
cost_model_correction.method_lesson: Read the transaction ledger for what a call cost. The balance only tells you what is left.
cost_model_correction.second_correction: The look-candidate preflight returned 0.25 and I reported that as the batch price. The ledger shows four separate -0.25 charges, so 0.25 was per image and the batch was 1.0. Immaterial here, wrong as stated.

affordability.note: The gap is caused by the concurrent spend, not by the batch price. It will widen if that spending continues.
